Triage notes (initial):
- Verified 429 spike across region us-west. Sample tail of logs shows identical client-side retry attempts at ~700 req/min for a subset of keys.
- Config audit: project finmed-prod -> tier mapping = standard-svc (expected), but org FINMED-001 global quota was erroneously left at "starter: 500 RPS" due to a migration script that failed to apply a commit earlier today. That mismatch causes gateway to apply the lower org quota and throttle projects despite higher project tier.
- Immediate mitigation options:
  a) Apply org-level temporary override to match standard-svc expected (increase to 2500 RPS) — low-risk, reversible via patch.
  b) Rate limiting rules: add short-lived bypass for existing connection pool between finmed-prod and model pool — higher risk.

I recommend option (a) now. I will prepare a quota-change patch and a rollback instruction. Need customer's OK to make the change under their org.

Attaching: draft quota-change.patch (will post to thread when ready).

— Vivek

Proposed immediate action: with your permission, Redwood will apply a temporary org-level quota override to align FINMED-001 with your project tier (increase to 2500 RPS). This is reversible and should stop the gateway from applying the lower global limit while we do a root-cause fix.

If you approve, we’ll apply the change immediately and monitor. We’ll also provide a rollback plan and a postmortem. We realize this is customer-impacting — apologies.
